text:
olivia-cs: Heads-up: prepping Acme QBR tomorrow 11am PT. Primary ask: token burn + forecast, and a short list of enablement blockers. Can we quick triage spend signals?
ben-cs: On it. Do we have current 30/60/90 day burn + top 5 routes that drove spikes?
maria-analytics: Snapshot ready — 30d = 1.2B tokens, 60d avg = 850M, projected next 30d = 1.5B if activation continues. Top routes: chat.generate, embeddings.create, rerank.score.
sam-ops: I see a surge on embeddings.create that aligns with last SDK. Suspect double-send on client side. Flagged in release-ops. @deploy-bot can you confirm if recent deploy touched the embeddings path?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: no rollback triggered. Latest helm diff shows no changes to the embeddings handler. Recommend throttling via routing policy while we triage.
ben-cs: For the QBR deck I need cause + mitigation per spike (one line each). maria, can you add per-route cost delta and a recommended alert threshold?
maria-analytics: Putting draft numbers here:
```
alerts:
  embeddings.create:
    threshold: 180000000/day  # tokens
  chat.generate:
    threshold: 50000000/day
  rerank.score:
    threshold: 15000000/day
```
Cost delta calc (30d vs prior 30d): embeddings +42% (~$3.6k), chat +8% (~$900). Will add exact USD mapping to the slide.
olivia-cs: Also surface renewal risk: Acme engineering said they'd consider pausing next month if costs exceed their forecast. @raj-sales do we have a committed tier option we can pitch?
raj-sales: We're close on a 6mo 20% committed capacity offer. Need legal to finish SOW. If they sign we can guarantee a per-token cap and dedicated pool to isolate noisy routes.
ben-cs: Action list: maria finish per-route cost delta table, sam validate SDK double-send and confirm client rollout, raj push offer draft to legal, olivia own the deck slide. I'll consolidate and produce the QBR talking points. 20-min sync in 20?
olivia-cs: :thumbsup: 20 works. Also want to include customer feedback — they asked for per-route billing transparency and an in-product soft cap. Can we show a mock UI snippet?
maria-analytics: I'll attach a sample billing table CSV to the deck. Quick CSV snippet here:
```
route,tokens,cost_usd
embeddings.create,720000000,3600
chat.generate,300000000,900
rerank.score,50000000,125
```
sam-ops: Temporary mitigation: pushed routing rule to throttle embeddings.create for Acme by 40% (targeted rule on customer-tag). Monitoring now — retries down ~70% in last 10m.
olivia-cs: Nice. If metrics hold we can propose a 'soft cap + alert' control for the customer in the QBR and offer the committed-cap discount as an option.
deploy-bot: alert created: channel=#customer-success, rule=acme_embeddings_spike, threshold=180000000/day
ben-cs: Great work team — I'll pull these into slides and ping when the draft is up for a quick review.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style; messages are chronological and all in one continuous string as required.
